use.flag: Use the v2fly project's geoip data (virtual/v2ray-geoip)
Use the Loyalsoldier enhanced geoip data (dev-libs/v2ray-rules-dat-bin[geoip])

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Virtual package that provides the V2Ray geoip.dat data file via the app-alternatives framework. Installs a symlink /usr/share/v2ray/geoip.dat pointing at the data file of the selected provider.
